digest.component_or_area: review-bot reconciler and retrigger acceptance paths
propositions: Accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests exist only as transient _rebar_force events in process-local asyncio queue and disappear on process loss while Gerrit vote and stale SQLite dedup rows persist, causing reconciliation to skip re-review of the revision

Both acceptance paths must reset the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review:0 before acknowledgement to emit a durable patchset-bearing comment-added event that re-admits the change to reconciliation after process loss

Reconciliation must query Gerrit before consulting local dedup to detect when a reset-triggered neutral vote has cleared the block, then clear only the exact matching stale voted row and proceed to review

The reset operation writes a fixed neutral value 0 that contributors cannot influence and must succeed with verification of no nonzero votes before the forced event is enqueued or attempt budget is reset
Production Gerrit events-log probe confirmed all 551 LLM-Review label events are comment-added events carrying both patchSet.revision and patchSet.ref, validating the durable marker design

Process loss injection at the queue-discard seam combined with a replacement empty queue plus retained stale dedup must be recovered by a single reconcile pass consuming the reset-emitted event and casting exactly one new vote for the exact revision
